admission.justification: Hide-behind-launcher needs both the rail panel wrapper and its state hook; typed per-case proofs were withdrawn as extractor-unsupported.

applicability: Selected-document chat presentation in Operations and the review page’s chat column, including Operations documentless scope with or without a matching Projects Architect.
conditions: A matching unarchived Projects Architect counts as an effective agent target.
An unknown answer is not confirmed absence and does not hide the existing application.
A review whose task document is pending or unknown has its own unbound scope and no admissible role; it never borrows the documentless Projects Architect binding.

While that review task is pending, the available retained frame stays visible and out of reach under the task-list wait line. When the task is known to be missing, the available frame hides behind the named problem line without a launcher or chat read.
A known bound review task with no effective chat retains its bound unstarted-task launcher; opening the review or column dispatches no agent.
exclusions: Agent-bearing selections, which take the message-switch path.

evidence: sidebarChatStaysLoaded.test.tsx (ghost keeps element behind aria-hidden wrapper; return switches back) + model.ts documentChatBinding/documentChatAgent (unchanged)

statement: Only a selection known to have no effective agent (or with no admissible role) hides the loaded frame behind its launcher/problem text; unknown chat discovery keeps the existing frame visible, out of reach, under a named wait. A known effective target returns in that same frame, subject to qualified control recovery.
